title: Case 5: The Odd One Out
story: Two config files should be identical on every server. One server has a different setting and caused the outage.
goal: Compare /case/a.conf and /case/b.conf. Which setting key differs? Answer with the key name.
socratic: Which file is the oldest witness?
Do two files tell different stories?
Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
